name: familyhouse_exterior_tree
description: The cozy cottage sits in the far background while a friendly shade tree and the winding cobblestone path take center stage.

color_palette: Soft sage green (#8A9A5B) for shutters and garden plants, warm terracotta (#CC7357) for roof tiles and flower pots, and soft brown (#D69242) for the house walls to match the original exterior.

Lush olive green (#6B8E23) and fresh spring green (#A8D08D) for the foreground tree canopy and leaves, with warm sandstone beige (#D9B385) and cool pebble gray (#9AA3A8) highlighting the cobblestone path.
visual_style.architectural_style: The same charming, small-scale cottage with pitched roof, wide eaves, shuttered windows, small front porch, and stone foundation—unchanged in structure and perspective from the main exterior. The house is placed in the far background to keep the foreground emphasis on the tree and path, with scale consistent for small animal inhabitants.
visual_style.flora_fauna: A broad, friendly shade tree (oak-like) anchors the foreground beside a winding cobblestone path, while sunflowers, lavender, and low berry bushes continue around the house and fence line. Robins and butterflies frequent the tree canopy; bunnies and squirrels occasionally cross the path.
materials: Natural wood siding for the house exterior
Small cobblestones forming the garden pathway
Low stone edging along the flowerbeds
